questions: Section 12 gives a single 25-debit charge for elevated liver enzymes and refers only borderline chemistry to judgement. Where the enzymes are more than twice the upper limit of normal, is that same 25 charged, or does the desk treat an elevation of that degree differently (a higher debit, or a decline band)?

For a liver-enzyme elevation above twice the upper limit of normal with no alcohol history and no explanation on file, does the desk postpone pending repeat labs or a workup, or rate the file on the labs as they stand?
